name: lifting-core
description: Pure strength-training plans: exercise goals with their progression rule, workouts in cycle order, logged attempts with derived success, the increment / hold / deload decision and the StrongLifts 5x5 template — plus, behind the `lifting-core/fhir` subpath, the FHIR R4 `CarePlan` / `Goal` / `Observation` adapters. Pounds only. No DOM, no platform imports.
